distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Taiwan and adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Honghe. Mainland China is therefore promoted to Present, and the reviewed distribution is Yunnan + Taiwan.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as polyphagous and cites Paulownia timber imported to Japan from Taiwan; this remains imported-material context and is not promoted as a China host. Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hadrodemius globus (Blandford, 1896).
